corrections.why: The register calls the south site a wooden tower that worked with the steel tower, and the Long Island list also calls it a wooden tower, so 'platform' is not supported

notes_for_editor: The build year is not given beyond 'after 1932' in the register, so no built event is recorded. Removal year disagrees: the register's south page says 1956 with the steel tower; the Long Island list says 1955 or 56; the register's north page says 1955 for the steel tower. The story reports all three. Only the register says nothing remains; the Long Island list says concrete footers remain at the north site, which does not describe the south site. No source describes public access, so facts.access is omitted. The 'kind' correction is proposed for human review, not applied.
